name: BTS76 (Hubble)
blurb: BTS76, a dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: leda2832100-hubble
story: A small, irregular dwarf galaxy that Hubble could barely break into single stars. Its red giants stayed too faint to see, so it lies farther away than its motion had suggested.

claims.text: BTS76 is a dwarf irregular galaxy
On the HST/ACS images BTS76 is barely resolved into stars without signs of the red giant branch
BTS76 has only a lower distance limit from HST that exceeds its earlier Hubble-flow estimate
